ActivationManifest.description: The facts one route generation's ``manifest.json`` records.
ActivationManifest.title: ActivationManifest

AdmissionCode.description: The shared admission lock refused because capacity is held by another admission.
AdmissionCode.title: AdmissionCode

AgentDirective.description: Authenticated heartbeat response for deadline renewal and cancellation.
AgentDirective.title: AgentDirective

AgentEvidenceCode.description:
Optional agent evidence that was dropped so the mandatory report is kept.

An agent report carries a mandatory core (identity, lease, capacity, outcome)
and optional evidence (NICs, the NAS route, fabric details, readings,
progress, diagnostics). Invalid optional evidence is never a reason to refuse
the core: the evidence is dropped and one of these words names what was lost,
on the agent that dropped it and on the Controller that received it.
AgentEvidenceCode.title: AgentEvidenceCode

AgentGenerationPointer.description: The active identity generation, switched last when an identity rotates.
AgentGenerationPointer.title: AgentGenerationPointer

AgentIdentityMetadata.description: The certificate facts persisted beside an agent identity's key.
AgentIdentityMetadata.title: AgentIdentityMetadata

AgentProgress.description:
The fence is the mandatory lease heartbeat; the progress document is
optional evidence, dropped when invalid so the lease is still renewed.
AgentProgress.title: AgentProgress

AgentReadinessReceipt.description: The Controller-accepted proof that this exact agent process is running.
AgentReadinessReceipt.title: AgentReadinessReceipt

AgentResult.description:
The fence, state and outcome (its failure identity: reason, error code,
summary, kind) are mandatory; the diagnostics, the failing stage and the
helper's own code are optional evidence, dropped when invalid so the outcome
is still recorded.
AgentResult.title: AgentResult

AgentResultState.description:
The state words of an agent result on the wire.

Unknown effects are observed by the Controller with bounded retries. The
retired operator-wait spelling is adopted only when reading old receipts.
AgentResultState.title: AgentResultState

AgentUpgradePayload.description: Signed package authority for the current agent upgrade operation.
AgentUpgradePayload.title: AgentUpgradePayload

AgentUpgradeResult.description: Evidence emitted after the Rust agent reports an exact upgrade.
AgentUpgradeResult.title: AgentUpgradeResult

ArtifactDistributionPayload.description: The complete payload accepted by the artifact transfer operation.
ArtifactDistributionPayload.title: ArtifactDistributionPayload

ArtifactLifecycleCode.description: Why an artifact (model file, image archive, blob) cannot be removed, referenced or changed right now.
ArtifactLifecycleCode.title: ArtifactLifecycleCode

ArtifactPreparation.description:
The stages of an artifact job before it is submitted.

These are preparation, not execution: a job is ``draft`` while its inputs are
uploaded and ``ready`` once they are complete.  Its lifecycle ``state`` begins
at ``queued`` on submit and is absent until then.  The old spelling kept both
in the one ``state`` word, which is why :func:`legacy_preparation` exists.
ArtifactPreparation.title: ArtifactPreparation

AssetAvailability.description: What is known about a model asset on a Spark's disk.
AssetAvailability.title: AssetAvailability

BlockerCategory.description: The categories of the blocker allowlist (fail-closed raises).
BlockerCategory.title: BlockerCategory

CacheReferenceReason.description: What keeps a cached artifact from being removed.
CacheReferenceReason.title: CacheReferenceReason

CatalogCode.description: Refusals of the recipe catalog and the recipe library documents.
CatalogCode.title: CatalogCode

CatalogSyncCode.description: Catalog synchronisation refusals and per-item problems.
CatalogSyncCode.title: CatalogSyncCode

CatalogSyncState.description: The outcome of a catalog synchronization, as the catalog shows it.
CatalogSyncState.title: CatalogSyncState

CertificateState.description: The standing of a node's client certificate, as the fleet projection shows it.
CertificateState.title: CertificateState

ClaimRequest.description:
The claim identity is mandatory; the hostname and the last preflight
fingerprint are hints, dropped when malformed instead of refusing the claim.
ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest

ClusterMappingCode.description: Refusals of a cluster mapping (recipe-to-Spark assignment) request.
ClusterMappingCode.title: ClusterMappingCode

CompiledJobInput.description:
Typed compiled form of the public ``RecipeJobInput`` declaration;
inputs are staged read-only under /inputs.
CompiledJobInput.title: CompiledJobInput

CompiledJobInputSlot.description:
Agent-side parity model for the public ``RecipeInputSlot`` contract.

The agent protocol wheel intentionally cannot import the public recipe
contracts wheel.  Keep this fixed wire structure in lockstep with that
source contract; engine-specific job parameters remain elsewhere in the
job request and are deliberately extensible.
CompiledJobInputSlot.title: CompiledJobInputSlot

CompiledRuntimeImage.description:
A runtime image in the Controller's layered store.

``image_digest`` is its manifest digest and ``oci_layout_sha256`` the same
digest's hex, its address in the store; ``image_bytes`` is the size of its
layers. Sparks pull it into Docker as
``localhost/vonk/compiled-runtime-<oci_layout_sha256>@<image_digest>``.
CompiledRuntimeImage.title: CompiledRuntimeImage

CompiledSecurity.description: Per-workload security choices; everything else is a platform constant.
CompiledSecurity.title: CompiledSecurity

CompiledSecurityMount.description: Model and input mounts are read-only; the output mount is writable.
CompiledSecurityMount.title: CompiledSecurityMount

ControllerErrorCode.description: Generic Controller request and fleet-operation problem codes.
ControllerErrorCode.title: ControllerErrorCode

ControllerRefusalBody.description:
The refusal body an older Controller returned: a bare code and/or detail.

A current Controller answers with its bounded error response; an agent that
meets an older Controller still has to recognise its refusal, so this shape
stays declared (and generated) instead of being read as an untyped document.
ControllerRefusalBody.title: ControllerRefusalBody

DesiredAssignmentState.description: What a fleet-profile assignment is asked to become on its Sparks.
DesiredAssignmentState.title: DesiredAssignmentState

DistributionAssignment.description:
What one node fetches for a distribution plan.

Model files are downloaded as objects. The runtime image is not an
object: the node pulls it by manifest digest from the Controller's
layered image store, and only the layers it lacks travel.
DistributionAssignment.title: DistributionAssignment

DistributionAssignmentState.description: Whether a node may still fetch the artifacts of a distribution assignment.
DistributionAssignmentState.title: DistributionAssignmentState

DistributionCode.description: Why a distribution assignment object cannot be served to a Spark.
DistributionCode.title: DistributionCode

DistributionObject.description: One model file referenced by an assignment.
DistributionObject.title: DistributionObject

EndpointState.description: Whether the endpoint of a fleet-profile assignment can be reached.
EndpointState.title: EndpointState

EnrollmentGrantState.description: The standing of an enrollment grant.
EnrollmentGrantState.title: EnrollmentGrantState

ErrorCatalog.description:
Carrier that publishes the error-category union into every generated surface.

Never sent: the wire schema, OpenAPI and the TypeScript client all emit the
tagged union as one ``OperationError``.
ErrorCatalog.title: ErrorCatalog

ErrorCategory.description:
The only three things a lifecycle adapter may raise or report.

``security-refusal`` and ``invalid-request`` are decided at submit time and
fail closed.  Everything else is ``unknown``: it is observed and reconciled,
never parked.  The blocker allowlist's ``already-retried`` and
``bookkeeping-debt`` families are both ``unknown`` (see
:func:`error_category_of`).
ErrorCategory.title: ErrorCategory

ErrorContextResponse.description: Safe context shared by public errors and generated clients.
ErrorContextResponse.title: ErrorContextResponse

FailureCode.description: Closed codes of a definite failed outcome reported by the agent.
FailureCode.title: FailureCode

FailureStage.description: The step an operation stopped at: a short, stable, secret-free word.
FailureStage.title: FailureStage

GatewayRouteState.description:
What the inference gateway currently serves: published routes, or maintenance.

``unavailable`` is the Controller's own word for a gateway whose marker it
cannot read; the gateway never writes it.
GatewayRouteState.title: GatewayRouteState

HelperErrorCode.description:
Every code the privileged helper, or the agent speaking about it, names as an error.

The helper builds its rejection from a member; the agent reads a reply code
through the enum, so a word outside it is a malformed rejection, never a code
the agent invents or forwards.  ``runtime_helper_*`` is the spelling of an
agent-side cause in failure evidence.
HelperErrorCode.title: HelperErrorCode

HostArchiveIdentity.description: The inode a loaded image archive had when it was received.
HostArchiveIdentity.title: HostArchiveIdentity

HostArchiveRuntimeImageReceipt.description:
The receipt an agent before the layered image store wrote for an archive.

An installation that names it keeps starting until it is replaced; the image
itself is still compared live.
HostArchiveRuntimeImageReceipt.title: HostArchiveRuntimeImageReceipt

HostHelperProcessLogs.description:
The exact failed container's own output, retained per stream.

The helper is the only party that ever holds the container's log, so it owns
the retention bound and reports it per stream.  Keeping the two streams
apart matters more than the bound: a merged document can only ever show one
tail, and whichever stream is written first is always the one discarded.
HostHelperProcessLogs.title: HostHelperProcessLogs

HostHelperResponse.description: Shared response shape; consumers also enforce their grant/action context.
HostHelperResponse.title: HostHelperResponse

HostHelperResponseStatus.description: The verdict a privileged-helper reply carries.
HostHelperResponseStatus.title: HostHelperResponseStatus

HostOperationOutcome.description: The privileged helper's durable result for one operation.
HostOperationOutcome.title: HostOperationOutcome

HostRuntimeImageReceipt.description:
The helper's proof that one pinned image was pulled to one local reference.

The manifest digest identifies the image in the Controller's layered store;
the daemon image id identifies the pulled object, so later uses compare it
live.
HostRuntimeImageReceipt.title: HostRuntimeImageReceipt

HostRuntimeRequest.description: The complete bytes hashed by the agent and admitted by the root helper.
HostRuntimeRequest.title: HostRuntimeRequest

ImageStoreCode.description: Refusals and damage found by the Controller OCI image store.
ImageStoreCode.title: ImageStoreCode

InstallAdmissionCode.description: Why an installation is not admitted (or is waiting) on a Spark.
InstallAdmissionCode.title: InstallAdmissionCode

InstallDegradedReason.description: Why an installation is shown partial in the fleet projection.
InstallDegradedReason.title: InstallDegradedReason

InstallationMetadataEntry.description: One file of an installation, as it was verified.
InstallationMetadataEntry.title: InstallationMetadataEntry

InstallationMetadataReceipt.description: The verified file set of one installed model.
InstallationMetadataReceipt.title: InstallationMetadataReceipt

InstallationNodeState.description: The condition of one rank of an installation on its Spark.
InstallationNodeState.title: InstallationNodeState

InstallationReconciliationCheckpoint.description: Where a recipe installation's reconciliation stopped, for crash recovery.
InstallationReconciliationCheckpoint.title: InstallationReconciliationCheckpoint

InstallationReconciliationReceipt.description: The helper's record of the installation a reconciliation removes.
InstallationReconciliationReceipt.title: InstallationReconciliationReceipt

InstallationState.description: The condition of a recipe installation across its Sparks.
InstallationState.title: InstallationState

InstallerReleaseManifest.description: Candidate and acceptance-only baseline are the two current graph roles.
InstallerReleaseManifest.title: InstallerReleaseManifest

InvalidRequest.description: A malformed or out-of-contract request; it fails closed at submit time.
InvalidRequest.title: InvalidRequest

InvalidRequestReason.description: Closed reason codes of an invalid request (submit-time input validation).
InvalidRequestReason.title: InvalidRequestReason

InventoryRequest.description:
Canonical Controller body and Rust agent inventory wire shape.

The mandatory core is the capacity, pool, capability and version evidence.
The network interfaces, the NAS route and the fabric pair are optional
evidence: when one is inconsistent it is dropped (and named in
``evidence_warnings``) instead of refusing the core.
InventoryRequest.title: InventoryRequest

LibraryAssessmentCode.description: Why a library entry is not assessed runnable on the current fleet.
LibraryAssessmentCode.title: LibraryAssessmentCode

LibraryProjectionCode.description: Reasons the library projection truncates what it lists.
LibraryProjectionCode.title: LibraryProjectionCode

LifecycleEffect.description: What is known about the real-world effect of the work.
LifecycleEffect.title: LifecycleEffect

LifecycleEventKind.description: The kinds of event the pure transition function accepts.
LifecycleEventKind.title: LifecycleEventKind

LifecycleState.description:
The nine lifecycle states: the one vocabulary a stored ``state`` speaks.

``superseded`` is a definite, non-failed end: a newer request replaced the
work, so nothing is left for anyone to do.  The legacy spellings
(``waiting``, ``partial``, ``cancelling``, ``expired``,
``waiting-for-operator``) are *aliases*: see :data:`STATE_ALIASES`, the one
table that says what each of them means, per subject.
LifecycleState.title: LifecycleState

LifecycleSubject.description: The persisted models whose ``state`` the lifecycle core owns.
LifecycleSubject.title: LifecycleSubject

LifecycleVocabulary.description:
Carrier that publishes every vocabulary enum into the wire schema.

The model is never sent: it exists so the schema exporter, the Rust
generator and the OpenAPI/TypeScript generators emit each closed word set
from this one module.
LifecycleVocabulary.title: LifecycleVocabulary

MigrationStep.description: The migration steps of the blocker audit (section 5.6) that retire a writer.
MigrationStep.title: MigrationStep

ModelCacheBlockerCode.description: Why a model download plan is blocked or waiting.
ModelCacheBlockerCode.title: ModelCacheBlockerCode

ModelCacheCode.description: Model cache resolution, storage, removal and operation problems.
ModelCacheCode.title: ModelCacheCode

ModelCacheOperatorStatus.description:
The operator-facing word of a model-cache operation that is not a stored state.

``accepted``: the request is recorded and not yet picked up.  Every other state
an operator sees is a :class:`~vonk_agent_protocol.LifecycleState` (a cancel
under way is ``observing`` with its cancellation intent).
ModelCacheOperatorStatus.title: ModelCacheOperatorStatus

ModelFileState.description: The condition of one model file a node holds.
ModelFileState.title: ModelFileState

NasGroupReadableSecrets.description: Secrets read by capability-free containers through one supplementary group.
NasGroupReadableSecrets.title: NasGroupReadableSecrets

NasInstallTemplate.description: The canonical NAS Compose template with its install questions.
NasInstallTemplate.title: NasInstallTemplate

NasInternalValue.description: An environment value the installer writes without asking.
NasInternalValue.title: NasInternalValue

NetworkInterface.description: One NIC as the agent reads it from sysfs.
NetworkInterface.title: NetworkInterface

NodeOfflineReason.description: Why a node is shown offline in the fleet projection.
NodeOfflineReason.title: NodeOfflineReason

ObservationCause.description:
Why an attempt is being observed rather than settled.

An attempt that ended without a definite answer is ``observing``; this says
what left it unanswered.  ``reported-unknown``: the executor said it could not
confirm the effect.  ``lease-lapsed``: the executor stopped reporting.  The old
spellings carried this in the state word itself (``waiting-for-operator`` and
``expired``), which is why an adopted attempt also yields its cause.
ObservationCause.title: ObservationCause

ObservedAssignmentState.description: Where a fleet-profile assignment stands on the Sparks, as observed.
ObservedAssignmentState.title: ObservedAssignmentState

OperationCheckpoint.description: Restart-safe cursor identifying a durable operation unit.
OperationCheckpoint.title: OperationCheckpoint

OperationFailureCode.description: Error codes of a stored operation failure evidence record.
OperationFailureCode.title: OperationFailureCode

OperationMemberProgress.description: Progress for one node, rank, shard, or other operation member.
OperationMemberProgress.title: OperationMemberProgress

OperationProgress.description: Canonical durable progress payload shared by Controller and agents.
OperationProgress.title: OperationProgress

OperatorActionName.description: The operator actions a row can advertise and the core accepts.
OperatorActionName.title: OperatorActionName

OperatorSurface.description: The real surfaces behind an advertised action in the blocker allowlist.
OperatorSurface.title: OperatorSurface

OutcomeCatalog.description:
Carrier that publishes the outcome union into the wire schema.

Never sent: it lets the schema exporter and the generators emit the tagged
union as one ``OperationOutcome``.
OutcomeCatalog.title: OutcomeCatalog

OutcomeDone.description: The effect is established; ``result`` is the operation's success body.
OutcomeDone.title: OutcomeDone

OutcomeEvidence.description:
Typed facts an executor attaches to a failed or unknown outcome.

Every field is bounded and already sanitized by the agent; the Controller
sanitizes again at ingress.  ``diagnostics`` holds the bounded diagnostic
logs, ``helper_error_code``/``helper_exit_code`` the privileged helper's own
verdict, ``stage``/``diagnostic`` the phase and a one-line cause.
OutcomeEvidence.title: OutcomeEvidence

OutcomeFailed.description:
A definite failure.

``receipt`` is the process receipt of a one-shot recipe job whose process
ran and exited nonzero; every other failure reports ``code`` and ``reason``.
OutcomeFailed.title: OutcomeFailed

OutcomeKind.description:
What an executor reported, as the lifecycle core sees it.

``done``, ``cancelled`` and a ``failed`` that is not retryable are
*definite*: the executor says what happened, and the row ends there.
``unknown`` (and a retryable failure) says the effect may or may not have
happened, which the core resolves by observing it.  On the agent wire a
cancellation is a definite ``failed`` outcome with the
``operation_cancelled`` code.
OutcomeKind.title: OutcomeKind

OutcomeUnknown.description: The executor could not establish the effect.
OutcomeUnknown.title: OutcomeUnknown

PackageActivationPhase.description: Where a package activation transaction stands.
PackageActivationPhase.title: PackageActivationPhase

PackageRollbackTransaction.description: The root-custody package activation transaction, restored after a crash.
PackageRollbackTransaction.title: PackageRollbackTransaction

PlacementInstallState.description: How much of a placement's installation is already on its Sparks.
PlacementInstallState.title: PlacementInstallState

PlacementLoadState.description: Whether a placement's recipe is loaded on its Sparks.
PlacementLoadState.title: PlacementLoadState

PrebuiltImageCode.description: Why a prebuilt runtime image is, or is not, used.
PrebuiltImageCode.title: PrebuiltImageCode

ProfileReasonCode.description: Reasons a fleet profile cannot be applied or is waiting.
ProfileReasonCode.title: ProfileReasonCode

ProgressPhase.description: What an operation is doing, as the measured progress names it.
ProgressPhase.title: ProgressPhase

ProjectionCode.description: Warnings and attention items of the fleet and library projections.
ProjectionCode.title: ProjectionCode

ReasonCodeVocabulary.description:
Carrier that publishes every reason-code enum into the wire schema.

The model is never sent: it exists so the schema exporter, the Rust
generator and the OpenAPI/TypeScript generators emit each closed word set
from this one module.
ReasonCodeVocabulary.title: ReasonCodeVocabulary

RecipeBuildAdapter.description:
The adaptation stage applied after the recipe image is built.

``adapter_sha256`` is the canonical digest of ``definition``.  The agent
re-derives it from the received definition and refuses to adapt when they
disagree, so a Controller/agent drift cannot silently install a different
adaptation than the one the prepared-image identity recorded.
RecipeBuildAdapter.title: RecipeBuildAdapter

RecipeBuildAdapterDefinition.description:
One reviewed, digest-identified platform adaptation of a built image.

The recipe Dockerfile owns the pinned upstream runtime, compilation, model
patches and engine arguments.  The platform owns the final Vonk contract
layered on top of that built image: the ``ai.vonkforge.runtime-interface``
label, the canonical ``/opt/vonk/bin/<engine>`` launcher and the runtime
user/ownership.  Hosting that in one reviewed adapter instead of recipe
boilerplate requires an identity that changes when the adaptation changes,
so this definition -- not the compatible ``v1`` label -- is what the digest
covers.  ``containerfile`` is the rendered, ordered adaptation stage and is
the only content the builder executes.
RecipeBuildAdapterDefinition.title: RecipeBuildAdapterDefinition

RecipeBuildCleanupEvidence.description: The build service is stopped; the fenced attempt is the whole answer.
RecipeBuildCleanupEvidence.title: RecipeBuildCleanupEvidence

RecipeBuildCleanupRequest.description: Stop only the transient service belonging to one retained build attempt.
RecipeBuildCleanupRequest.title: RecipeBuildCleanupRequest

RecipeBuildCode.description: Recipe image build planning and recording problems.
RecipeBuildCode.title: RecipeBuildCode

RecipeBuildLimits.description:
Resource limits; builds never get a GPU, privileges, host mounts or a
container socket.
RecipeBuildLimits.title: RecipeBuildLimits

RecipeBuildNetwork.description: Public hosts the build may reach; an empty list builds offline.
RecipeBuildNetwork.title: RecipeBuildNetwork

RecipeBuildRequest.description: Build one recipe image for linux/arm64.
RecipeBuildRequest.title: RecipeBuildRequest

RecipeImageCode.description: Runtime image availability, preparation and cache-removal problems.
RecipeImageCode.title: RecipeImageCode

RecipeJobInputManifest.description: Declared user files; manifest.json itself is platform metadata.
RecipeJobInputManifest.title: RecipeJobInputManifest

RecipeJobOutputManifestContent.description: Canonical output bytes hashed before the manifest digest is attached.
RecipeJobOutputManifestContent.title: RecipeJobOutputManifestContent

RecipeJobRunRequest.description: One job run; interface, image, placement and timeout come from the plan.
RecipeJobRunRequest.title: RecipeJobRunRequest

RecipeOperationRequest.description: Typed lifecycle request envelope with an operation-specific payload.
RecipeOperationRequest.title: RecipeOperationRequest

RecipePackageCode.description: Recipe package download and verification problems.
RecipePackageCode.title: RecipePackageCode

RecipeReconcilePayload.description: Authority to remove one managed install with an invalid launch contract.
RecipeReconcilePayload.title: RecipeReconcilePayload

RecipeReconcileResult.description: A reconciliation succeeds with an empty result.
RecipeReconcileResult.title: RecipeReconcileResult

RecipeReconciliationIdentity.description: The install a reconciliation removes, carried through the cleanup grant.
RecipeReconciliationIdentity.title: RecipeReconciliationIdentity

RecipeRunInspectionRequest.description:
Helper frame for one read-only inspection of a managed run.

Unlike every other helper operation it needs no Controller grant: it only
reports whether the exact container of an agent-written ``run-inspect``
runtime request is running.
RecipeRunInspectionRequest.title: RecipeRunInspectionRequest

RecipeRunObservationWire.description: What the agent saw of one local run generation.
RecipeRunObservationWire.title: RecipeRunObservationWire

RecipeRunObservationsWire.description:
The agent's current observation of every locally managed run.

``observed_at`` is taken before the agent lists its local runs, so a run
the Controller changed after that instant is never overwritten by it.
RecipeRunObservationsWire.title: RecipeRunObservationsWire

RecipeStartPayload.description: Start one rank; placement, image and addresses come from the plan.
RecipeStartPayload.title: RecipeStartPayload

RecipeStartResult.description: The serving rank reports its endpoint; every other rank reports ``{}``.
RecipeStartResult.title: RecipeStartResult

RecipeStopResult.description: A stop succeeds with an empty result.
RecipeStopResult.title: RecipeStopResult

RecipeUninstallResult.description: An uninstall succeeds with an empty result.
RecipeUninstallResult.title: RecipeUninstallResult

ReconcileCode.description: Why an installation reconcile is blocked.
ReconcileCode.title: ReconcileCode

RequestValidationIssue.description: A structural input error without the submitted input or validator context.
RequestValidationIssue.title: RequestValidationIssue

ReservationState.description: The standing of a resource reservation.
ReservationState.title: ReservationState

ResourceBlockerCode.description:
The capacity-fit codes the resource planner gives a node that cannot fit.

``insufficient`` is the family prefix a run admission maps onto
``run.insufficient_memory``; the planner itself names the exact
``insufficient_capacity*`` member.
ResourceBlockerCode.title: ResourceBlockerCode

ResourcePlanningCode.description: Resource planning (memory, disk, parallelism) refusals and unknowns.
ResourcePlanningCode.title: ResourcePlanningCode

ResourceTerm.description: The effective settings whose capacity cost the resource planner derives.
ResourceTerm.title: ResourceTerm

ResourceTermProblem.description: What is wrong with the evidence for one resource term.
ResourceTermProblem.title: ResourceTermProblem

RoutePublicationState.description: The phases of one atomic route publication.
RoutePublicationState.title: RoutePublicationState

RouteState.description: Whether a run's inference route is published to the gateway.
RouteState.title: RouteState

RunAdmissionCode.description:
The typed codes a run admission names for a refusal, blocker or wait.

``capacity_busy`` is lock contention only.  Every other reason an admission
must wait or is refused carries its own member, so a waiting operation shows
the real cause.  The retryable blockers (a plan that may become admissible
by itself) are a subset the Controller derives from these members.
RunAdmissionCode.title: RunAdmissionCode

RunDegradedReason.description: Why a run is shown degraded in the fleet projection.
RunDegradedReason.title: RunDegradedReason

RunLifecycleRecord.description:
The lifecycle a running recipe was started with.

Tolerant of fields an older or newer agent wrote: an unknown field must not
make a retained run unreadable.
RunLifecycleRecord.title: RunLifecycleRecord

RunState.description: The condition of a recipe run (and of each of its ranks).
RunState.title: RunState

RunSwitchCode.description: Run/Switch phase blockers, waits and failure codes.
RunSwitchCode.title: RunSwitchCode

RuntimeGenerationFence.description: The highest run generation admitted for one runtime, and whether it ended.
RuntimeGenerationFence.title: RuntimeGenerationFence

RuntimeImageCode.description: Runtime image preparation, receipt and registry problems.
RuntimeImageCode.title: RuntimeImageCode

RuntimePreflightFinding.description:
One capability's verdict.

``code`` travels as the word of a :class:`RuntimePreflightFindingCode` member.
It stays a pattern-bound string on the wire so an older agent's free-text
code (``available``, ``proc-mount-denied``) and a newer agent's word still
read; :attr:`finding_code` is the typed reading of either.
RuntimePreflightFinding.title: RuntimePreflightFinding

RuntimePreflightFindingCode.description:
Why one runtime preflight capability passed, failed or stayed unknown, as the agent reports it.

The agent builds every finding from a member; the Controller reads a code an
older agent sent as free text through :func:`adopt_preflight_finding_code`.
RuntimePreflightFindingCode.title: RuntimePreflightFindingCode

RuntimePreflightRequest.description: Check this linux/arm64 host can run one recipe runtime.
RuntimePreflightRequest.title: RuntimePreflightRequest

SecurityRefusal.description: A refused request at a security boundary; it fails closed.
SecurityRefusal.title: SecurityRefusal

SecurityRefusalReason.description:
Closed reason codes of a security refusal: a real security boundary.

Authentication and authorization, identity and certificate expiry, node
revocation, enrollment, signed package metadata, host-helper authority,
tombstone fencing, credential denial and the digest-bound destructive-effect
checks of Run/Switch.  ``failure_classification`` derives its code set from
this enum, so the Controller and the contract cannot disagree.
SecurityRefusalReason.title: SecurityRefusalReason

SitePorts.description: The ports the Spark firewall authorises, read by Controller and setup.
SitePorts.title: SitePorts

SourcePolicyCode.description: Findings of the build source policy (Dockerfile and Compose rules).
SourcePolicyCode.title: SourcePolicyCode

SparkApplyEnvelope.description: What the privileged phase of the Spark setup applies, in one frame.
SparkApplyEnvelope.title: SparkApplyEnvelope

StateAlias.description:
The retired spellings of a stored lifecycle state.

They are accepted as input for one release (API filters, CLI arguments) and
adopted when an old row is read; nothing writes them any more.  This is the
only place the words may be spelled: the vocabulary ratchet allows them
nowhere else.
StateAlias.title: StateAlias

StateWriteKind.description: The shapes of a lifecycle state write the writers ratchet recognises.
StateWriteKind.title: StateWriteKind

StopOutcome.description: Whether an idempotent stop confirmed that the effect is gone.
StopOutcome.title: StopOutcome

StopPlanCode.description: Why a stop plan is stale or cannot be taken.
StopPlanCode.title: StopPlanCode

StorageDemandCode.description: Storage demand outcomes of an admission.
StorageDemandCode.title: StorageDemandCode

SupersedeCode.description: Why a fleet profile application was superseded by newer intent.
SupersedeCode.title: SupersedeCode

SupervisorAcknowledgement.description: One live, ready child acknowledging an exact route activation.
SupervisorAcknowledgement.title: SupervisorAcknowledgement

TelemetrySample.description:
One host sample. The capacity scalars are the core; the 4.1 readings
(temperature, CPU clocks) are optional evidence dropped when invalid.
TelemetrySample.title: TelemetrySample

UninstallPlanCode.description: Why an uninstall plan is blocked or incomplete.
UninstallPlanCode.title: UninstallPlanCode

UnknownError.description: Anything else: observed and reconciled, never parked.
UnknownError.title: UnknownError

WaitReason.description:
Typed reason codes for an effect that cannot be confirmed (the *unknown* kind).

Each code names the one fact the executor could not establish.  The free
text of a report is for people; the Controller decides on this code.
WaitReason.title: WaitReason

WaitVerdict.description: The verdicts of the blocker allowlist for an operator wait.
WaitVerdict.title: WaitVerdict
